brief:
Former Israeli military chief Gadi Eisenkot said Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu cannot remain in office, citing alleged meddling in recent elections, Al Jazeera English reported. Arab party members were reportedly arrested before voting based on unfounded evidence originating from the PM's office.

Eisenkot's statement adds to mounting criticism of Netanyahu's conduct surrounding the electoral process and the treatment of Arab political figures in Israel.
dek: Arab party members were reportedly arrested before Israeli elections based on unfounded evidence from the PM's office.
title: Eisenkot accuses Netanyahu of ineligibility over election interference
